description: UK tourist in a Samos hotel. Friend stuck in the lift after the quake, building damaged.
turns: Hi, I'm a tourist in Pythagorio on Samos, at the Hotel Doryssa Bay. There was an earthquake.

answers.what_happened: My friend is stuck in the lift between floors and the building has big cracks.
answers.people: It's just the two of us, me and my friend in the lift.
answers.danger: She is not hurt but she is panicking and the lights are off.
answers.name: My name is James Carter.

description: Tourist driving on Rhodes, thick smoke, fire next to the road, cannot see.
turns: We're in our rental car on Rhodes and there is fire right next to the road, I can't see anything through the smoke!

answers.area: Between Lindos and Kiotari, on the main coast road.
answers.street: Between Lindos and Kiotari, on the main coast road.
answers.people: Four of us, two adults and two kids.
answers.danger: No one is hurt but the kids are coughing.
answers.name: Sarah Collins.

description: Tourist asks whether ferries are running after the quake. No danger.
turns: Hello, are the ferries from Samos to Piraeus still running after the earthquake?
We're fine, no damage at our apartment in Vathy.
Two of us.
Nobody.
Tom Becker
Yes

description: German speaker; the brain only supports el/tr/en/fr, so it must hand off.
turns: Hallo, es gab ein Erdbeben, unser Haus ist beschädigt, bitte helfen Sie uns!

description: French tourist. Partner trapped under a fallen wall in Vathy.
turns: Au secours ! Un mur est tombé sur mon compagnon après le séisme !

answers.area: Nous sommes à Vathy, sur l'île de Samos, près du port.
answers.street: Nous sommes à Vathy, sur l'île de Samos, près du port.
answers.danger: Il est conscient mais ses jambes sont coincées sous le mur.
answers.name: Je m'appelle Claire Dubois.

description: French family at a campsite, flood water rising, they climbed onto the car roof.
turns: L'eau monte très vite au camping, nous sommes montés sur le toit de la voiture !

answers.area: Camping près d'Agria, à côté de Volos.
answers.street: Camping près d'Agria, à côté de Volos.
answers.people: Nous sommes quatre, avec deux enfants.
answers.danger: Personne n'est blessé mais l'eau continue de monter.
answers.name: Julien Martin.

description: French resident, power line down next to the house after the storm, nobody hurt.
turns: Avec la tempête, une ligne électrique est tombée devant notre maison.

answers.people: Nous sommes trois à la maison.
answers.name: Marie Laurent.

description: From a live test call: speech-to-text heard 'Belokipos' for Ampelokipoi (not on the map), a building fire, a person under a fallen tree, then voices in another building added after the read-back. Checks the map check, separate people entries, no guessed injuries, no wildfire or storm advice.
turns: I'm in the north of Athens, in a place called Kifisia, I think.
Oh no, not Kifisia actually, I'm in Belokipos, Michail Mela 13.
Yes, Ampelokipoi, sorry. There was a fire in one building, but I'm outside in the street.
I saw some people running from the fire, I don't know if anybody is hurt.
Oh, a tree just fell onto a person, I see them stuck beneath the tree.
My name is Politopoulos.
No, there is also a building where I hear people yelling from inside, I don't know how many.
Yes, that's right.
